variants.tagline: By tide and by tiller, the Eastwall bound.

quotes.text: The sea forgives in salt what land forgets in stone.
quotes.attribution: Erevan, on the way to Eastwall

quotes.text: A short voyage is the best voyage. So saith the seasick paladin.
The compass is a courteous fiction. The wind is the rule.

variants.tagline: Blacktarn tasted thee, but did not finish.

quotes.text: A torch lasts an hour. Blacktarn lasts longer.
The first rule of a dungeon is light. The second is who is behind thee.
Goblins are not stupid. They are merely fewer than thou. Adjust accordingly.

variants.tagline: Stonereach stands, and so dost thou.

quotes.text: Honor is what you do when no one watches.
An oath sworn in haste is still an oath.
The Shrine of Honor was here before the city. The city is the Shrine's idea.
The Codex is real. It is also exactly as far away as it has always been.
Begin with the lies thou tellest thyself. The rest is bookkeeping.
There are Eight, and they are not in order of importance, but each in service of the others.
